# gigahost_dns_ptr_zone (Resource)

A reverse DNS (PTR) zone owned by the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_ptr_zone" "example" {
  prefix     = "185.181.63"
  ip_version = "ipv4"
  zone_name  = "63.181.185.in-addr.arpa"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (String) `ipv4` or `ipv6`.
- `prefix` (String) IP prefix in bare or CIDR form. Accepted: `185.181.63` or `185.181.63.0/24`; `2a03:94e0::` or `2a03:94e0::/32`. The canonical CIDR form is stored in state; bare and CIDR forms are treated as equivalent.
- `zone_name` (String) PTR zone name, e.g. `63.181.185.in-addr.arpa` or `0.e.4.9.3.0.a.2.ip6.arpa`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Generated zone ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# PTR zones appear in the standard zone list alongside forward zones.
# Find the zone ID or arpa zone name:
#   gigahost dns zones list
terraform import gigahost_dns_ptr_zone.example ZONE_ID
# ...or import by arpa zone name:
terraform import gigahost_dns_ptr_zone.example 63.181.185.in-addr.arpa
```
